ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (off-white) pixels, with heavy concentration of low-intensity values in the central peduncle region and along the leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark central wedge extending from the notch; large white contiguous regions on the mid-to-outer lobes. Extensive dark mottling and punctate spots scattered within the high-intensity regions, specifically in the lower-quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 110 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total lobe vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with medium-frequency variations; pixel amplitudes are more pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes near the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lobes exhibit a symmetrical convex curve transitioning into tapered, slightly upward-curving tips; trailing edge follows a non-linear concave path toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of circular dark-on-white pixel groups localized in the lower-central white regions of the left lobe and lower-mid section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical and oblique dark linear disruptions visible on the white field of the left lobe, appearing as non-contiguous rake-like marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity, rough-textured protrusions (likely barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark 'island' of pigmentation isolated within the white field on the lower section of the right lobe, adjacent to the water line.
